result.topic_en: Euler gives the successive divided-difference formulas for the interpolation coefficients A, B, C, D, E, explicit closed forms for B, C and D in terms of p, q, r, s, and a faster recursive scheme for computing them.
result.transcription:
— 160 —
hincque formentur hae:
$Q' = \frac{Q-P}{bb-aa};\ R' = \frac{R-P}{cc-aa};\ S' = \frac{S-P}{dd-aa};\ T' = \frac{T-P}{ee-aa};$ etc.
$R'' = \frac{R'-Q'}{cc-bb};\ S'' = \frac{S'-Q'}{dd-bb};\ T'' = \frac{T'-Q'}{ee-bb};$ etc.
$S''' = \frac{S''-R''}{dd-cc};\ T''' = \frac{T''-R''}{ee-cc};$ etc.
$T'''' = \frac{T'''-S'''}{ee-dd};$ etc.
Quibus valoribus inuentis habebimus:
$A = P;\ B = Q';\ C = R'';\ D = S''';\ E = T'''';$ etc.

Corollarium 1.
§. 2. Cum sit $P = \frac{p}{a}$, erit primus coefficiens $A = \frac{p}{a}$; pro sequentibus vero, ob:
$Q' = \frac{aq-bp}{ab(bb-aa)};\ R' = \frac{ar-cp}{ac(cc-aa)};\ S' = \frac{as-dp}{ad(dd-aa)};$
$T' = \frac{at-ep}{ae(ee-aa)};$ etc.
erit secundus coefficiens
$B = \frac{aq-bp}{ab(bb-aa)}$ seu $B = \frac{p}{a(aa-bb)} + \frac{q}{b(bb-aa)}$.

Corollarium 2.
§. 3. Cum porro sit
$R'' = \frac{ar-cp}{ac(cc-aa)(cc-bb)} - \frac{aq-bp}{ab(bb-aa)(cc-bb)}$, fiet
$C = \frac{r}{c(cc-aa)(cc-bb)} + \frac{q}{b(aa-bb)(cc-bb)}$
$+ \frac{p}{a(cc-aa)(bb-aa)}$,
quae forma ita concinnius exhiberi potest, ut sit:
$C = \frac{p}{a(aa-bb)(aa-cc)} + \frac{q}{b(bb-aa)(bb-cc)}$
$+ \frac{r}{c(cc-aa)(cc-bb)}$.
Corol-

— 161 —
Corollarium 3.
§. 4. Simili modo calculum vlterius prosequendo reperietur:
$D = \frac{p}{a(aa-bb)(aa-cc)(aa-dd)} + \frac{q}{b(bb-aa)(bb-cc)(bb-dd)}$
$+ \frac{r}{c(cc-aa)(cc-bb)(cc-dd)} + \frac{s}{d(dd-aa)(dd-bb)(dd-cc)}$
vnde formam sequentium quantitatum E, F, G, etc. iam tuto coniectura assequi licet.

Scholion.
§. 5. Plerumque autem expeditius singulorum coefficientium A, B, C, D, E, etc. valores ex praecedentibus definiuntur: Ex aequationibus enim fundamentalibus deducuntur formulae sequentes:
$A = \frac{p}{a};$
$B = \frac{q-bA}{b(bb-aa)};$
$C = \frac{r-cA}{c(cc-aa)(cc-bb)} - \frac{B}{cc-bb};$
$D = \frac{s-dA}{d(dd-aa)(dd-bb)(dd-cc)} - \frac{B}{(dd-bb)(dd-cc)} - \frac{C}{dd-cc};$
$E = \frac{t-eA}{e(ee-aa)(ee-bb)(ee-cc)(ee-dd)} - \frac{B}{(ee-bb)(ee-cc)(ee-dd)}$
$- \frac{C}{(ee-cc)(ee-dd)} - \frac{D}{ee-dd};$
etc.
vbi plerumque mox eiusmodi ordo obseruatur, vnde sequentes facile deriuari possunt, quemadmodum ex sequentibus problematibus, in quibus hanc methodum ad quosdam casus particulares sum accommodaturus, patebit.
Euleri Opusc. Anal. Tom. I.     X     §. 6.

items.quote: Simili modo calculum vlterius prosequendo reperietur:
items.english: In a similar way, by continuing the calculation further, one will find [the stated formula for D].

items.quote: vnde formam sequentium quantitatum E, F, G, etc. iam tuto coniectura assequi licet.
items.english: From this one may now safely obtain, by conjecture, the form of the following quantities E, F, G, etc.

items.quote: vbi plerumque mox eiusmodi ordo obseruatur, vnde sequentes facile deriuari possunt
items.english: Here, usually, an order of this kind is soon observed, from which the following ones can easily be derived.

items.quote: quemadmodum ex sequentibus problematibus, in quibus hanc methodum ad quosdam casus particulares sum accommodaturus, patebit.
items.english: This will become clear from the following problems, in which I shall adapt this method to certain particular cases.
